data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 7% (2021: 10%) component of the 2022 loss ratio of 47% (2021: 46%). The earned loss ratio represents net incurred losses divided by net earned premium.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1225 recorded a net gross prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 18.6m (about 2.0% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 932.2m) at 31 December 2022. Development across underwriting years was mixed: adverse movements in some older years (notably increases in 2017 and 2019) were partly offset by releases in other years (2018 and 2020). The Managing Agent attributes prior-year movement largely to changes in claims experience, described as driven mainly by favourable loss experience overall in the narrative, although the gross triangle shows a small net strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit 'Prior years' claims estimate' table appears to present movements that are likely net of reinsurance; the gross prior-year development was therefore derived from the gross claims development (triangle) as a fallback. This produces a net gross strengthening of GBP 18.6m, which contrasts with a stated 'favourable movement in technical provisions' figure (44.7) in the note that appears to be net. Consequently there is moderate uncertainty reconciling gross vs net movements.
